review.metadata: runtime.latest_call_tool forwards its fourth and fifth arguments as arguments and meta to latest_connections.call_tool. The stdio thread_hint schema is an empty object with additionalProperties=false and its handler reads context.meta['threadId']. Passing {} plus canonical threadId metadata corrects the observed missing-hint path.
review.guard_retention: The HeptaGovernance and active-tool-policy no-call guards, token-budget/context-window gates, environment=None, no-wait/default-timeout arguments, latest connection route, .ok() error handling, content extraction and context rendering remain byte-identical outside the three-line argument move/comment.
review.finish_owner: The private helper waits only after TurnComplete, passes that completed.turn_id to the existing observer and awaits its returned future after all registry locks are released. The observer filters TaskTerminalizationKind::Finish plus exact owner turn ID; it neither claims nor retires owners. The task publishes TurnComplete before persistence, marker release, pending work and finish completion. Both parameterized cases use this helper immediately before the next submit_turn.
review.coverage_retained: All existing compaction lifecycle, request count, window lineage, hidden-tool exposure, developer context and regex assertions remain unchanged. No deadline, feature, policy, production terminalizer, or retry changes.
review.limits: The closed compaction failures contain the generic ten-second event timeout, not a per-owner scheduling trace. The omitted finish observation is a source-proven reachable interleaving; native success remains unmeasured.

gate_binding.note: This source review is not a test receipt. Tests were still active when the attachment was assembled.
